verdict.rationale: Kit's Broadcasts API lets a developer create and update broadcasts programmatically. A broadcast record carries HTML `content` and references an email template (kit-docs-70, kit-docs-66, kit-docs-71), and custom-field keys act as personalization tags in broadcasts and sequences (kit-docs-74). This gives a thin path to pushing HTML with variable substitution from code. However, there is no evidence of a template-management API, MJML support, or any version-control or template-versioning capability; keeping files in git would be a user-side workaround. Missing for 10: API endpoints to create/update reusable email templates, MJML or templating-language support, documented variable-substitution syntax, version control/history for templates, independent corroboration.
